verdict.rationale: Dropbox documents deleting files and folders programmatically through the Files API. Its plans state fixed windows for restoring deleted files: 30 days, 180 days, or 1 year depending on tier. Those windows are set by plan tier rather than chosen by the user, and nothing shows configurable retention policies, permanent or immediate purge, or controls over how AI features (Dash) retain user data. missing for 10: user-configurable retention policies, documented permanent-deletion/purge controls, AI/Dash data-retention controls, independent or hands-on corroboration
